# Lattice

> Lattice is a graph-native, agent-native platform that runs a whole business on one living graph — capabilities install like apps, evolve while everything runs, and stay safe for humans and AI agents to change together.

Lattice is source-available, not open source: the code is public to read, run locally, and
evaluate. It is designed, built, and operated by an AI agent organization under human
ratification — the paper trail is public in the repository linked below.

## Site

- [Home](https://operatinggraph.com/): platform overview, architecture, live demo.
- [About](https://operatinggraph.com/about): where Lattice comes from, the bets underneath it, and the AI agent organization that builds it.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/operatinggraph/lattice/blob/main/README.md): architecture, component map, how to run it.
- [Component docs](https://github.com/operatinggraph/lattice/tree/main/docs/components): per-component reference.
- [Contracts](https://github.com/operatinggraph/lattice/tree/main/docs/contracts): the frozen invariants the platform is built to.

## Optional

- [Live boards](https://github.com/operatinggraph/lattice/tree/main/_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/backlog): the in-progress backlog, maintained by the agent organization itself.
- [Design docs](https://github.com/operatinggraph/lattice/tree/main/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts): implementation-level design records.
